avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, significantly reducing brivaracetam plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if previously used, monitor seizure control closely during discontinuation as brivaracetam levels will increase

avoid_supplements.name: Phenytoin-containing herbal products
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce metabolism of brivaracetam, reducing therapeutic levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; consider alternative seizure management if needed

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential weak CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce brivaracetam levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor seizure control; generally safe at standard doses but use with awareness

caution_supplements.name: Valerian root
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive CNS depressant effects with brivaracetam
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; counsel patient on potential increased dizziness or sedation

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression may increase dizziness, drowsiness, and impaired coordination
caution_foods.action: Counsel patient to limit or avoid alcohol; educate on safety risks with seizure disorder

monitoring_notes: Brivaracetam has relatively few direct food-drug interactions as it is not significantly affected by dietary components. Maintain consistent administration times and monitor for breakthrough seizures if CYP-inducing substances are added or removed from the regimen.
